headline: As of 2026-11-06: 73,815,358 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+8.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 73,815,358 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+8.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (10,311,597), Florida (8,331,690), Texas (8,173,920).
